name: Carpet and Allergies: What Helps and What's a Myth
title-tag: Carpet and Allergies: Facts vs Myths | Lynnwood, WA
meta-description: Is carpet bad for allergies? Messier than the myth. What helps — dense low pile, a sealed HEPA vacuum, hot-water extraction — and when hard floors win.
post-summary: December 10, 2026 · Carpet is not automatically the enemy of allergies — old, neglected carpet is. The spec that helps (dense, low, synthetic), why the vacuum matters more than the carpet, the hot-water extraction schedule, and the honest cases where allergists are right that bare floors win.
